description: Register one attendee for an event and issue their QR pass — the programmatic equivalent of a walk-up registration, useful for importing someone from another system. It does NOT take payment and does not raise an invoice: the registration is created as comped. Confirm the name and email with the user before calling this, because the attendee may be emailed. Calling it twice for the same person is safe: the existing registration is returned instead of creating a second one. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

email.description: The attendee's email. An existing account with this address is reused; otherwise a passwordless one is created.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name.description: The attendee's full name, as it should appear on the badge.

tier.description: Ticket tier — the value or label of an option on the event's registration form. Omit to register without a tier.

name: register_attendee
title: Register an attendee
